== Source, printing and count verification (Story 386) ==
The Players Committee post linked in the article's Sources (WordPress post 34682) was compared with the [[Media:26Worlds Hoyt LS Senate.txt|wiki-hosted XML download]] and the card identities displayed in the table. The download's File page attributes it to the forum distribution; the original forum ZIP has not been independently byte-verified.
The article contains 60 constructed cards and 29 outside-deck cards. The original download contains 60 constructed entries and 29 outside-deck entries. Its unchanged SHA-256 is <code>cce58fc6ec3d14fcf8ef0912964102e4b8a65ad7ad821820acf8d652e82b8968</code>. Constructed and outside-deck XML identities were checked separately; outside-deck vehicles and starships retain their own type groups.

=== Printing choices ===
* 2x [[General Kenobi (ALT) (Errata 2)]]: XML <nowiki>209_6^</nowiki>. The explicit image modifier is represented by the matching published ALT face.
* 3x [[Senator Palpatine (AI)]]: XML <nowiki>12_29</nowiki>. The PC post identifies <nowiki>3x Senator Palpatine (AI)</nowiki>. The source printing was matched to its existing card family and image.
* 1x [[Supreme Chancellor Valorum (AI)]]: XML <nowiki>12_31</nowiki>. The PC post identifies <nowiki>1x Supreme Chancellor Valorum (AI)</nowiki>. The source printing was matched to its existing card family and image.
* 1x [[Resolute (ALT)]]: XML <nowiki>221_71^</nowiki>. The explicit image modifier is represented by the matching published ALT face.
